docs.text: Why models err on new data. The three sources of error (bias, variance, noise), the decomposition, polynomial regression at increasing degree as the worked example, the bulls-eye picture, and a preview of cross-validation as the honest way to see the tradeoff.

docs.title: Why this matters
docs.text: The lens for every model choice in the unit: D09's depth, D10's bagging, D11's learning rate and D19's regularisation are all the same tradeoff in different clothes.
